contract.step_1: each BUY/SELL strategy marks the 40 tickers as uptrend state=1 or not state=0 at the monthly decision close
contract.step_2: only state=1 tickers are passed to the portfolio manager
contract.step_3: inside that subset, the B3 Strategy Lab champion filters ROC252/126/63 > 0, ROC22 > 0 and close > SMA200
contract.step_4: the manager ranks the survivors by ROC22 / annualized sample volatility18 and buys Top-1
contract.execution: decision at monthly close; trade at next common session open
contract.between_rebalances: hold the selected asset until the next monthly decision
